name: Living Faith
body:
Your religious practices give you no special powers over the undead.

Prerequisite: Ability to channel positive or negative energy

Effect: You lose the ability to affect undead with your channel energy ability. This does not extend to other creatures you might have the ability to affect with channel energy.
